title: Sun in Lidia
overview: Lidia goes with her mother, Gina, to the beach house where they used to vacation during her childhood. What should have been an opportunity to relax by the sea, begins to reveal unresolved issues in their relationship.

title: fly, little plane!
overview: A childhood dream of flight lingers into adulthood, reduced to a habit of watching planes pass overhead. As time moves on, wonder gives way to distance. Eventually, he looks away.

title: Prize
overview: A young rower is pushed beyond his limits by an ambitious new coxswain.

title: Since We’ve No Place To Go
overview: After a stranger arrives at their Christmas gathering, a family must grapple with the loss of their matriarch.

title: Violent Night 2
overview: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

title: Asterix: The Kingdom of Nubia
overview: The irreductible Gauls are turned into harmless children after a rare youth elixir accidentally ends up into the magic potion. To find the antidote and save the village from the Romans attack, Asterix and Obelix embark on a crazy journey to the far away Kingdom of Nubia.

title: The Man with the Bag
overview: After Santa’s magic bag is stolen, he turns to his naughty list to find Vance, a thief, to help him get it back. Along with his daughter, Santa, and a group of misfits, Vance will have to pull off the greatest heist of his life to save Christmas.

title: Le Faux Soir
overview: November 1943, German-occupied Belgium. In the face of grave danger if caught, the Independent Front, a Belgian resistance organization, publishes a spoof edition of Le Soir to satirize the German occupiers and the nation’s main propaganda-controlled newspaper. Le Faux Soir is considered the first act of media hacking in history.

title: One Minute to Midnight
overview: As he is about to separate from his partner, with whom he lives in Eastern France, 49-year-old Léo learns of the death of his biological father whom he never knew. Before traveling to Italy to deal with the inheritance, he spends a few days in Paris to take stock of his life. Between conversations with his activist daughter and encounters with ghosts from his past, he begins to question his very existence, and, above all, his relationships with women.

title: Flesh and Fuel
overview: A lonely French trucker's routine life on the road takes an unexpected turn when he encounters a Polish driver. As feelings develop, he struggles to balance his demanding job with a chance at love, determined to make their connection work.

title: Controlled: Can I Trust My Partner?
overview: Daisy Maskell investigates the shocking surge in partner abuse among under-30s, and enlists her boyfriend to help her expose the sinister ‘stalkerware’ apps used to spy on victims.

title: Table For Two
overview: A food critic with high standards realizes the flaws in perfection and redefines their relationship both with food and their partner through an out-of-body experience.

title: Ghollak
overview: A man falls into begging unintentionally and enjoys it.

title: Zero A.D.
overview: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.

title: Olaya
overview: The project portrays the life of a young Olaya, recounting the best of his childhood and adolescence.

title: Behemoth!
overview: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

title: Umka
overview: Live action adaptation of the soviet cartoon shorts Umka (1969) Umka ishchet druga (1970)

title: Очень сказочные дела
overview: All the inhabitants of the Far Far Away Kingdom are obsessed with three glorious heroes. Their battles are like rock concerts: they draw crowds of fans, merchandise is sold on every corner, and every child dreams of being like them. Among them is forty-year-old Elemelya, a simple-minded and awkward boy who also happens to be the president of the Three Heroes fan club, which includes three other children. At the royal feast, trying to get closer to his idols, Elemelya accidentally disrupts the knights secret operation to capture Koschey Bedrosovich. Koschey disappears along with the royal daughter. Now Elemelya is despised by everyone: the people, the tsar, his own fan club-but most importantly, he has disappointed his idols. To set things right, Elemelya, along with the chatty gusli player Alyoshka, sets off on a long journey to Koshchey's underbelly.

title: Jani Be Good
overview: A teenager named Jani holds resentment towards her mother, whom she holds accountable for her older sister's departure from home. Winnie, the single parent, is preoccupied with shouldering the family responsibilities, leaving little room to comprehend her two children. Both Winnie and Nainai (Jani's grandmother who lives with them) continue to anticipate Julia's return, while Jani maintains clandestine communication with her.

title: Above the Below
overview: Three astronauts survive a violently destructive re-entry, only to discover their landing capsule is sinking into the uncharted depths of the ocean. Completely cut off from the world, they must battle both the sea and their isolation to survive.

title: Boss Cat
overview: When her mother suddenly dies, Sonja is thrown into tumult. Dealing with early-twenties existential angst and a sense of responsibility for her teenage younger sister Emma, she has a lot on her plate. Suddenly under the care of her controlling grandma and—as a young woman living with Down syndrome—constantly faced with a society that judges what she’s capable of, Sonja is desperate to be herself and take charge of her own life. When a chance encounter with the charismatic Hakim leads her to a krump class, Sonja discovers a life-changing outlet for expression.

title: Pha Chan
overview: A young couple become entangled in the ritual of "Pha Chan," a practice that severs ties either between living people or between the living and the dead.

title: Christmas Adventure
overview: A ballet dancer from Macedonia comes to Mačkat, on Zlatibor, to meet his future wife's family. The differences in customs and mentalities lead to a series of hilarious but also emotional moments.

title: It Will Happen Tonight
overview: The film will explore contemporary emotions, fears, and relationships through intertwined stories, resembling Nevo's narrative style.

title: together apart.
overview: Sophie and Jojo have been separated for six months but still live together like a couple. Only when Sophie's parents—who are unaware of the breakup—make their continued financial support conditional on her having a child with Jojo does movement come into the stagnant lives of the two millennials.

title: Viver é Melhor Que Sonhar: A Vida De Belchior
Il mio nemico immaginario
overview: Emma, a curious and imaginative nine-year-old girl, loves unicorns, spaceships, and Christmas trees. She lives with her quirky family: her mother Sara, a molecular gastronomy enthusiast; her sharp-witted grandmother Loredana; and her stern father Leo, a science teacher worried about the fantasy world Emma inhabits. Emma’s imaginary friend, Mojito, helps her escape reality, but her parents—on the verge of separation—struggle to understand her. Meanwhile, Bob, Leo’s long-forgotten imaginary friend, reappears, trying to reconnect with him before vanishing forever. The story explores Emma’s journey to find a balance between her dreams, reality, and her family dynamics.

title: Cathedral
overview: A blind friend of the wife comes to visit a middle-aged married couple. The husband welcomes him with prejudice, but their relationship takes an unexpected turn that changes the way the husband sees the world and himself.

title: Exchange
overview: A mother searching for her missing 18-year-old exchange student daughter in Canada. As she investigates, she discovers an eerie mystery surrounding the host family and is forced to confront forces that may have taken over her child's body.

title: Tafers Code
overview: Tafers Code follows five teenagers at the T.A.F. language school in Itaquaquecetuba, guided by the charismatic Teacher Gilmar. Each episode explores the unique challenges and strengths of the students as they discover how learning English can transform their lives. With humor, emotion, and a touch of documentary style, the series culminates in a final project that inspires not only the characters but everyone to take the first step toward a brighter future through language learning.

title: Bakuken: Honnoji Temple Annihilation Chronicles

Through it all, Amy finds comfort, perspective, and plenty of laughter through sips of wine with her lifelong friend Rosie, whose warmth and wit become a vital anchor as both women navigate the shifting rhythms of approaching middle age.

title: Holly
overview: Holly arrives at church to pray for protection.  However, is greeted with an entity that craves her innocence.

title: In the Family 2
overview: Sequel to 'In the Family' (2017). Plot TBA.

To succeed, they must outsmart a vain police chief, a desperate small-time gangster known as the 'The Shrimp', and Wall Enberg himself—who will stop at nothing to get his revenge.

overview: Can we imagine an archaeology of the future? An unearthing of objects that have not yet been used, a reconstruction of societies that have not yet come to dance. And yet, traces guide an erratic movement from which all our rhythms seem to draw. There is, within archaeology, a visceral drive to reconstruct myths that might serve us as shelters—against which to contrast forms of community, of everyday life, of living.

title: A Grand Biltmore Christmas
overview: In 1895, Elizabeth meets Michael, a teen trespasser at Biltmore House who vanishes. When he returns 20 years later, a magic hourglass pulls her to the present. She must return home before being found and before love alters her destiny.

title: Anchorless
overview: During a trip to Brazil in 2022, Augusto (15), an introspective and dreamy young man, becomes enchanted by Antônio (16), a magnetic and unpredictable boy from Belém. Amid the heat of the World Cup and the waters reflecting a fleeting encounter, a fragile connection is born, stretching across distance when Augusto returns to Italy, turning desire into obsession. While Augusto loses himself in idealizations and the emptiness of delayed responses, Antônio continues his life between parties, friends, and fleeting loves. What begins as a promising romance crumbles under the weight of time, silence, and the things that were never said. As the years pass, Augusto is forced to face an inevitable truth: some loves do not belong to the future, they exist only in memory. An intimate and visceral portrait of love, loss, and growth, Anchorless delves into the fragility of first feelings and the pain of learning that not every story is destined to last.

Andre Rieu's 2026 Christmas Concert Let It Snow

Before adulthood, there was this.

overview: A retelling of the events of 9th November 1974 when a group of teenagers saw an unidentified object flying over Salem Mountain.

title: Maishafko Mohani

One night, the prince dreams of meeting his dream princess at the enchanting Godawari Park in Lalitpur. As he approaches her, they share a magical connection filled with joy, romance, and beautiful dance moments. In his dream, the prince expresses his admiration for her beauty, grace, and charming personality. As their bond grows stronger, he proposes marriage to her, and she happily accepts his proposal. Together, they celebrate their love through playful moments, romantic dances, and heartfelt expressions. The song takes viewers on a dreamy journey where love feels limitless and reality fades away. Through colorful visuals, graceful performances, and romantic chemistry, Maishafko Mohani portrays the timeless fantasy of finding one’s perfect love. It is a beautiful dream of a prince who sees his beloved princess as the most beautiful woman in his world.

title: Bismillah
overview: Haunted by his failure at his Bismillah as a 4 year old, Azhar (Adolyn H. Dar) seeks redemption by re-doing the ceremony - 30 years later as an adult.

title: ADEM

The father isn't attending the wedding; he's been banished from the family. Jacques is marrying Martine, a young woman who lives in the same neighborhood. It's a love match. But can love heal the wounds of childhood?

overview: Between the end of one session and the start of the next, the collective desire to bring a film club to life collides with the ghosts of precariousness and the decay of cultural spaces.

Her peaceful life is filled by conversations with quirky cemetery workers and the many visitors who share their stories of love, loss, and life. However, her routine is disrupted when a local police chief arrives at her door with an unusual request. As they grow closer, Violette comes to understand that the truth behind long-buried mysteries in her past must be uncovered if she wants to take another chance on life and, against all odds, love.

title: Big Polio

title: The Debut

title: Bunker
overview: When an architect accepts a morally ambiguous project — building a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire — his wife begins to question their marriage after 17 years together.

title: Gregorius, the Chosen One
overview: Gregorius, the Outcast. As an infant, he was abandoned by his own parents, conceived through the sinful love of a brother and sister. As a young man, misunderstood in a humble fishing village, he imagined the lake as an ocean, a small boat as a throne, and a spear as a royal sceptre. Yet deep within, he knew he was destined for something greater. Driven by a desire to become a knight and make the world a better place, Gregorius embarks on a journey that reveals the unfathomable ways of God. For within every sinner, there may also dwell a saint. Whether you are an outcast, a knight, a king, a hedgehog, or a pope, beneath the heavens there is ultimately only one true path: the path of a pure heart. Gregorius, the Chosen One.  Inspired by Thomas Mann's novel, Tomasz Mielnik's poetic absurd comedy transports audiences to a long-lost age, when the star-filled sky served as a map of endless, radiant, and irresistible journeys.

title: Watkins Law
overview: A decade after Jallow's  sexual relationship with his teacher, Miss Watkins, they meet again and are forced to confront the past they never quite escaped.

Violating more and more ethical norms, a scientist absorbed in this idea kidnaps two children. Their mother will have to stop Ivan and prove that his experiments do not lead to perfection, but to the loss of humanity by himself.

title: I Built a Rocket Imagining Your Arrival
overview: Fifty-something Rosa, lying in an MRI scanner, is prompted to summon a happy memory. She plunges into a meandering, subconscious road trip with her indomitable mother, both queer, where wild imagination becomes a tender, unruly form of therapy.

title: CAMPUS IMMETIRI
overview: CAMPUS IMMETIRI follows an unseen observer attempting to understand nature through observation, memory, and measurement. The more they try to make sense of the landscape, the further it slips from comprehension, until the attempt itself becomes a failure.

title: Para Vigo Me Voy!
overview: A Documentary about the Brazilian Filmmaker Carlos Diegues and His Works.

overview: Sophie joins a prestigious tennis academy, where the brutality of competitive sports is taken to its extreme and only the hungriest survive.

Follows society woman Clarissa as she prepares to host a party at her home in Lagos, Nigeria, where she will unexpectedly encounter once-intimate friends from her youth. As the group reflects on their shared past over the course of a single night, memories of their intricate relationships, passionate love, hidden desires, and lost aspirations give rise to bittersweet reckoning.

title: Super Space Sheriff Gavan Infinity VS Raiya

title: Ink
overview: An explosive cinematic rollercoaster about a group of misfits and visionaries who had an idea for a new kind of news - one that would give the people what they want, and would change the face of the world we live in today.

title: The Apothecary Diaries: The Deceased Empress' Treasure
overview: The story follows Maomao and Jinshi as they travel to the hometown of a concubine who died five years ago in the imperial harem, to return her remains to her homeland. There, they encounter pirates, hidden treasures, the secret of the Empress' remains, and a mysterious boy who holds the key to the story.

title: Duped (The Jezbel Experience)

Elijah Martinez finds himself ensnared in a romantic involvement with Alexandria Wright, an unfaithful Covert Narcissist. She convinces him they are soulmates and they take a vow before God for His blessing with the penalty of betrayal being death. After years pass, Alexandria forgets the vows and begins cheating behind Elijah's back. Just a week before Christmas, she abruptly betrays him. To his astonishment, she swiftly transitions to a new relationship, bringing with her the unsettling secret of transmitting an incurable sexually transmitted disease to her new partner. Then came Karma. Her victims arrive to spit on her dirty grave as her demise finally arrives.

title: Rose Hobart 2
overview: Rose Hobart haunts the cinema.

overview: After having disturbing dreams, James believes he's responsible for the murders of two women and decides to turn himself in.  Detective Hobson must determine if James is bluffing or if there's something more sinister at play.

overview: Unaware that they are both involved with Capucine, Henri and Charles debate historical and literary figures in a Parisian bookstore.

title: A Penny Weighs More Than a Soul
overview: "A Penny Weighs More Than a Soul" is a powerful documentary by Tobias Demetz (TD Films) that takes viewers deep into the untouched nature of the Dolomites. The story centers on the extraordinary life of Ulrich Senoner, who lives far from modern civilization at the secluded Malga Futura. Without electricity or running water, he embodies a nearly forgotten human resilience. This film is a visual tribute to the silent strength of a man who chooses the wilderness over comfort, showcasing the fragile balance between Alpine tradition and a rapidly changing world.

title: Isn't It Called True Love?
overview: Harry, a young tradie relives moments of love and loss, confronting the question of what someone would do for love once its gone?

title: Play Date
overview: A couple shows up for a dinner party, and slowly realize it's not that kind of party.

title: ARSIP 07: Rekaman Yang Tidak Pernah Dipublikasikan
overview: Four content creator friends—Raka, Naya, Kevin, and Bima—who love exploring horror, decide to visit a mysterious building known as the Three-Story Building, a building without doors, windows, or rooms that stands in the middle of a rice paddy. With their cameras as witnesses, they intend to prove that the haunted stories circulating are just myths.  However, from the moment they enter the building, various illogical events begin to haunt them. Mysterious voices, a dark figure visible only through the camera, and illusions of space and time trap them in an inexplicable terror. When the exit seemingly disappears and the footage begins to show a different reality, they realize that something has been watching them from the beginning.  ARSI 07: Unpublished Footage is a mockumentary and found footage horror film that creates suspense through seemingly real footage, with an ending that leaves the question: did they really escape, or have they become part of the archives forever lost?

title: Playing War
overview: In war, people's lives are at stake; in this world, people are the object of a child's whim, which can lead many to break their worldview... literally.

Hunted by his former architects, he seeks sanctuary within the echoing halls of the Musée d’Orsay—one of Paris’s final "safe zones" in a world of total digital surveillance. There, among the relics of the past, he must join a clandestine resistance to protect the future of human autonomy.

His inability to trust leads to a final, devastating decision that destroys their lives and leaves a haunting legacy in the mountains

But when a mission goes sideways, he's given one last shot at redemption: track down and eliminate Mason Ryker, the final ghost of the feared underground unit known as The Order of the Dragon. As Rico's mission leads him to a small, danger-ridden town in Serbia, the lines between good and evil begin to blur. Is Ryker the monster he's made out to be, or is there a deeper conspiracy at play? What begins as a black-and-white hit spirals into a moral storm-and time is running out.

Bound by shared struggles and a tangled history, Aaron and Santiago navigate the toxic undercurrents of fame and friendship. As Aaron embarks on his next masterpiece, his chaotic life threatens to destroy everything he holds dear.

title: Lau Kumude Hidyo Hero Banna
overview: Lau Kumud Hidyo Hero Banna is an inspiring music video about dreams, friendship, and the journey of becoming a hero. Kumude leaves his home in Dang with big dreams in his heart and travels to Kathmandu to become a hero. On the way, he meets his two close friends who support him and help change his style with black sunglasses, black jeans, a tough jacket, and stylish black Dingo shoes. Looking smart and confident, Kumude walks proudly like a real hero. During the journey, he meets a kind tempo rider girl who supports and encourages him. Their adventure becomes difficult when the tempo tyre gets punctured on the road. Later, a helpful truck driver gives Kumude a ride towards Kathmandu. As they travel through hills, rivers, forests, and beautiful landscapes, Kumude enjoys the beauty of Nepal and learns that becoming a hero needs courage, confidence, friendship, and belief in dreams.

Haunted by fame and fractured family ties, Michael embarks on a personal journey to reunite the Jackson Five—his brothers, his roots, and the harmony he lost. But the path to healing is far from simple. As old tensions resurface and new wounds emerge, Michael must navigate the complex legacy of his past while staying true to the joy that first ignited his voice.  Set against the backdrop of forgotten towns and abandoned recording studios, Michael reconnects with each of his brothers in a heartfelt odyssey across America. With Brad and Samantha by his side, and Goku occasionally crashing in with unsolicited wisdom, Michael learns that sometimes saving the world starts with saving your family.  Stripped of supervillains and secret councils, Michael discovers that history isn’t just what you’ve lived through—it’s what you choose to remember, reclaim, and rewrite in song.

overview: Spanning decades, cultures, and quiet family secrets, Sunnyside is an intimate documentary portrait of Nicholas, a second-generation Greek-American reflecting on a lifetime of memory, identity, and profound transformation. From a cramped childhood bedroom in Sunnyside, Queens, to summers at a Long Island bungalow, the film explores the contrast between a rigid city upbringing and the fleeting freedom of youth. As Nicholas tells stories of his own path—architectural journeys in Paris, coming to terms with his identity in 1970s New York, and finding true partnership—he uncovers unspoken truths about his family's immigrant sacrifices and long-buried grief. Now the sole survivor of his family of seven, Nicholas preserves their fragile legacy, offering a deeply poignant meditation on what it means to hold the key to a forgotten past.
